claim: TikTok Indonesia disclosed to Indonesia's parliament that 8 million creators earn income through TikTok's own monetization features, of which 63% earn more than Indonesia's minimum wage -- a platform-specific figure, not a national cross-platform census.
stance_target: TikTok platform-specific creator monetization and income levels in Indonesia
scope_conditions: Indonesia, TikTok platform only, disclosed 15 July 2025 at DPR Komisi I hearing
quoted_support: "125 Juta pengguna aktif yang datang ke TikTok setiap bulannya, dimana ada 8 juta kreator berpenghasilan melalui fitur monetisasi TikTok. 63 Persen di antaranya berpenghasilan lebih dari upah minimum di Indonesia."

claim: TikTok Indonesia reported 21 million local sellers on TikTok Shop and Tokopedia combined, with 60% of promotional content on TikTok supporting local products.
scope_conditions: Indonesia, TikTok Shop and Tokopedia platforms, 15 July 2025
quoted_support: "21 Juta penjual lokal seluruhnya Indonesia ada di TikTok Shop dan Tokopedia"

claim: TikTok reported having trained 180,000 creators and UMKM (small business) participants in Indonesia, and that over 5 million business entities/UMKM use TikTok.
stance_target: TikTok's stated support programs for Indonesian creators and small businesses
scope_conditions: Indonesia, TikTok platform, as of 15 July 2025
quoted_support: "Saat ini bisa dilihat ada lebih dari 5 juta entitas bisnis dan UMKM memanfaatkan TikTok. Ada 180 ribu kreator dan UMKM telah menerima pelatihan dari TikTok."

claim: The 8-million/63%-above-UMR figure attributed to Indonesia's Menekraf in a separate speech is numerically identical to TikTok's self-reported platform-specific monetization data, indicating the ministerial 'national' claim likely derives from a single platform's disclosure rather than an independent government census.
stance_target: the notion that the Menekraf's 8-juta/63-persen figure is an independent national government estimate
scope_conditions: Indonesia, cross-source comparison between Menekraf speech and TikTok DPR testimony
quoted_support: "ada 8 juta kreator berpenghasilan melalui fitur monetisasi TikTok. 63 Persen di antaranya berpenghasilan lebih dari upah minimum di Indonesia."
